YourAIFinder helps you choose. → Search by Task or Persona — find tools matched to what you actually do → Compare 2–4 tools side by side — your choice, one page → Explore by price — interactive table with real budget filters → AI Tool of the Day — fresh editorial picks, daily → Alternatives pages — top 10 comparison tables for every major tool Built for people who need to decide, not just discover.

records.name: SVG Stroke Studio
records.tagline: Turn your SVG logos/icons into hand-drawn animations
records.description: A single-purpose tool that does one thing well instead of a motion suite you rent forever. You upload your SVG, trace the path a pen would take across your logo/icon. That stroke becomes a mask, and your artwork is revealed as it draws. Per-stroke width, order and pauses defined, then export animated SVG, MP4, WebM or GIF. No account, no sign-in, your artwork is never stored. Free to use and preview. $3.50 once per project to export. No subscription.

records.name: Nestido
records.tagline: The shared custody calendar that fills itself in
records.description: Nestido is a custody calendar for separated parents. State your custody rhythm once, alternating weeks, 2-2-3 or your own, and the months ahead fill themselves in: from then on you only record what differs. Moving the whole sibling group to the other parent takes two taps. It counts in nights, never in hours, and tells you how many nights with each parent over any period. One account is enough, the other parent has nothing to install. No messaging, no expense splitting, no ads.

records.name: Cialis 20mg x 25 Pills – USA
records.tagline: Cialis 20mg x 25 Pills USA – Product Information & Details
records.description: Cialis 20mg x 25 Pills USA contains tadalafil, a prescription medicine commonly used for erectile dysfunction (ED). The product listing specifies 25 pills with a 20mg strength. Tadalafil works by supporting increased blood flow and may also be prescribed for certain symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). As a prescription medicine, it should be used only under medical supervision, with attention to potential interactions and individual health considerations.
